pendingRefinements.problem: The source viewer shows code but long lines are cut off at the target width, with no visible horizontal scroll affordance in the captured state.
pendingRefinements.suggestion: Add a check that code-view lines remain reachable at 1280px through wrapping or horizontal scrolling.

pendingRefinements.problem: Code source is technically present but long lines are clipped in the screenshot, and the rubric does not state how the source remains accessible at 1280px.
pendingRefinements.suggestion: Require selected source to remain readable through visible horizontal scrolling or wrapping at 1280px and 375px.

refinementLog.problem: pages.json workbench routes use /projects/demo which 404s (no seed + deviceId cookie), so harness capture cannot produce official workbench PNGs
refinementLog.suggestion: Document a capture precondition (seed project or post-submit route) or change pages.json workbench routes to a deterministic seeded fixture reachable without prior device cookie
refinementLog.note: pages.json keeps only capturable static home; workbench evidence requires authenticated post-submit Playwright journeys (documented in tech-design + RB-2). /projects/demo is not a seeded fixture in F2.

refinementLog.problem: RL-3 covers both missing Chinese timeline progress AND blank 预览; this pitfall only checks the timeline half, leaving blank preview to RB-30
refinementLog.suggestion: Keep RB-10 timeline-only but explicitly say preview blankness is scored by RB-30 so judges do not double-count or miss either half
refinementLog.note: RB-10 description now states timeline-only RL-3 half; preview blankness is scored exclusively by RB-30.

refinementLog.problem: Current wording allows passing on tabs alone while preview paint can still fail RL-3
refinementLog.suggestion: Require screenshot evidence of identifiable mock UI pixels in 预览 (not only srcdoc/DOM presence)
refinementLog.note: RB-13 now requires screenshot evidence of identifiable mock UI pixels in 预览, not tabs/srcdoc alone.

refinementLog.problem: Item checks presence of 继续 on interrupt but not absence on completed success
refinementLog.suggestion: Score 1 only when 继续 appears iff run is interrupted; completed runs must not show interrupt recovery chrome
refinementLog.note: RB-22 (and RB-39) now require 继续 / interrupt recovery chrome iff run is interrupted; completed runs must not show it and must not keep 运行中.

refinementLog.problem: Existing e2e asserts srcdoc markers only; that can pass while the painted iframe is blank
refinementLog.suggestion: Add a visual assertion (non-uniform iframe clip / accessible text via probe) so blank paint cannot greenwash srcdoc presence
refinementLog.note: RB-30 and E2E-1 now require a visual paint assertion (non-uniform iframe clip or accessible probe text); srcdoc markers alone cannot pass.
